title: The Hunt
camera: lateral tracking with KAIRO, then settle as he kneels
action: KAIRO moves cautiously through waist-high dry grass, spear low and ready. He stops, notices tracks, and kneels down to inspect them.
lighting: sunrise side light raking the grass, warm bounce from below
audio: grass brushing against legs, soft footsteps, insects, low wind
dialogue_fa: اون روز رفته بودم دنبال شکار. راستش گرسنه بودیم و چاره‌ای هم نداشتیم. باید چیزی برای خوردن پیدا می‌کردم.
gloss_en: That day I had gone out to hunt. Honestly, we were hungry and had no choice. I had to find something to eat.
transition: he kneels, motivating the cut to the footprint close-up
image_prompt: Medium profile tracking shot of KAIRO the stickman walking through waist-high golden dry grass in prehistoric Africa, wearing a simple brown animal-hide tunic, bare feet, a wooden spear held low in his right hand. Sunrise side light rakes the grass, long shadows, acacia trees soft in the background. Painterly 2D animation, warm dust in the air.
video_prompt: Lateral tracking shot following KAIRO through the tall grass. He pushes stalks aside with the spear shaft, stops, glances down at fresh tracks, and kneels slowly out of frame bottom. Grass sways in the wind, dust motes drift. Camera settles as he kneels.
